_readme: Rename to tunetune-config.json to use it. Every line is optional. relays, saavnServers, piped and invidious are FREE sources: always used, tried before the built-in ones. musicServers are YOUR servers: used only when 'My server' is switched on in the app, only after every free source (and tunetune-sources.json) failed, and before the YouTube player. Give each server a name so the app can show which one is playing.
